Down the well: jump, fire your boots, stomp the enemies

Hold a finger: the player walks to that column. A second finger jumps on the ground and, held in the air, fires downward; a quick tap or an upward flick with one finger also jumps. Landing or stomping an enemy refills the ammo.

Take a number, the taxman takes its divisors: divisor sense and planning
Take a number that still has a divisor on the board; the taxman takes all of its remaining divisors. When nothing can be taken, the rest goes to the taxman. Higher total wins

Take turns picking from 1–9; three of your numbers adding to 15 win
Take turns picking a number from 1–9. If any three of your numbers add up to 15 you win; when all nine are gone it is a draw
Place the numbers on the magic square: every row, column and diagonal adds to 15. So you were really playing tic-tac-toe
ZA: zero ads, zero permissions, pure play. Free and open source:
ZA collects no data, asks for no permissions and never connects to the network. Scores and settings live only on this device and go away when the app is uninstalled.

Pseudo-3D racing: drive against the clock, overtake rivals, master the curves

The throttle is automatic. Touch the left half to steer left, the right half to steer right; the middle strip or a second finger brakes. Checkpoints add time; the race ends when time runs out. Overtaking scores; avoid cones and oil, ride the turbo strips, grab the yellow box.
Everyone drives the same track today; three attempts a day.
No attempts left today; a new track tomorrow!
Left/right half: steer · middle strip or a second finger: brake
Vertical space shooter: drag the ship, auto-fire; waves, bosses, power-ups

Drag the ship with your finger in any direction (moving up gets you closer, and riskier); firing is automatic. Clear the enemy waves; every 5th wave brings a boss. Consecutive hits raise the multiplier; collect the drops: W weapon, S shield, B bomb, + points. BOMB wipes bullets and damages everything on screen.
Everyone fights the same waves today; three attempts a day.
No attempts left today; a new fleet tomorrow!
Drag the ship in any direction
The bomb button sits on your thumb\'s side; the setting is shared with Kuyu, Geçit and Viraj

The shelf plan is set; your job is stock. Each day decide how many cases to order per product: orders arrive the next morning, what does not fit is returned, stock left at night pays holding, expired units are waste. The target is the profit of an expert seeing the same forecasts.

Paddle game: against the computer, two players on one phone, or a rally against the wall

Drag the paddle with your finger: where the ball hits sets the angle, the paddle\'s motion adds spin. The ball speeds up with every hit. First to 11 by two wins; in wall mode the score is the length of the rally.
Easy follows the ball, medium predicts it, hard hits with the edge
Each player drags in their own half; the top player\'s score faces them
The ball comes back off the wall with a slight deflection; the paddle shrinks every 8 hits
Everyone gets the same ball today; the best rally is recorded
Piano tiles: tap the lane of the falling tiles, the melody is in your fingers

Four lanes, one tile per row. Tap the lane of the next tile and a note of the melody plays; tapping the wrong lane ends the run. In Classic hit 50 tiles as fast as you can; in Endless the flow speeds up and ends when a tile gets away.
Everyone gets the same piece and the same lanes today; 3 attempts a day, the fastest time is recorded

Hold to climb, release to dive: an endless flight between rooftops, power lines and rival kites

Holding pulls the string and the kite climbs; release and it sinks. Don\'t hit rooftops or wires. Pass above a rival kite to cut its string; pass below and yours gets cut. Collect ribbons, complete missions, unlock gear.
Everyone flies the same sky today; 3 attempts a day

Rescue divers by submarine: oxygen, sharks, mines and the Bosphorus current

Drag the submarine with your finger; torpedoes fire on their own in the direction you face. Collect divers (up to 6) and surface to deliver them. Oxygen drains while diving and refills at the surface. Sharks, enemy subs, torpedoes and mines cost a life; current bands push you sideways.
Surfacing without divers after a dive costs a life · full load (6) +300

Lane defense: guard the garden from crows, rabbits, goats, boars and bears with wells, sprinklers, scarecrows, hives and traps

Raiders come down five lanes from the forest; each one that reaches the hut costs a life (3 lives). Tap a card, then a cell: the well makes water, the sprinkler jets its lane, the scarecrow blocks the path, the hive sends bees across three lanes, the trap blasts whoever steps on it once armed. Tap falling drops for +25 water. The shovel removes a defender.
Clearing a wave brings the next one early · every 3rd wave is big · every level is generated winnable by an expert policy

Vertical climb up a plane tree: tap left or right to jump to the next branch; dry branches, snakes, crows and a cat on your tail

The squirrel climbs the plane tree branch by branch. Tap left or right: it jumps to the nearest branch above on that side (up to two steps); if there is none, it falls. A dry branch snaps a second after you land, never land on a snake, and crows knock you off as they cross your branch. The cat is climbing the trunk and gets faster the higher you go: keep moving. Nut +20, golden nut +100, every step +10.
A safe branch is always within reach · a tap during a jump is queued and applied on landing
Everyone climbs the same tree today; 3 attempts a day

A farmer with a sprayer pump against a descending grasshopper swarm: one-shot rule, hay bales, the queen

The swarm descends in formation; at the edge it turns and drops a notch, and it speeds up as it thins. Drag: the farmer walks. Tap: spray. One-shot rule: you cannot spray again until the previous shot hits or leaves the field. Spit erodes the bales and costs a life when it hits the farmer (3 lives). If the swarm reaches the farmer\'s row, the field is overrun. The queen crosses the top now and then: bonus.
Black 30 · green 20 · brown 10 · queen 100–300 · wave bonus 100 × wave · bales are never repaired
